title: 删除版式
description: Rail tools for the layout being edited: 删除版式 deletes an unused layout at once. A layout that pages still use asks first, and the confirmation says how many pages lose the layout's content. Page-owned content is kept.

kimiUi.location: 左侧「母版与版式」列表，当前版式下方
kimiUi.appearsWhen: on a layout surface (not the master)

preconditions.notes: The committed layouts-project layout 正文 is in use (22 pages), so this row exercises the confirmation. An unused layout deletes at once.

steps: 版式仍有页面使用时，在确认框点击「删除」；未使用时直接删除

pptd.summary: layoutDelete removes the layout definition; pages lose only the inherited copies

selfTestChecklist: deleting an unused layout is immediate; a layout in use asks first
